artworks.title: Laundresses
artworks.description: The image depicts a riverside scene with a horizon dividing the sky and land. Clouds are visible along the horizon, with horizontal striations in the sky. A tree bends over a river, and two figures are seen in the water near the reeds. The artwork features detailed hatching to convey texture and shadow. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown.

artworks.title: Mountain Stream
artworks.description: The image shows a mountain landscape with a low horizon, towering mountains dominating the central and left parts. Rugged peaks are seen in the distance against a sky filled with textured clouds. The artwork features intricate lines depicting rocky surfaces and clouds. The color scheme is primarily brown, providing a timeless appearance. A river flows past rocks and sparse vegetation, surrounded by scattered trees.

artworks.title: Mountain River
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on chine collé
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a high horizon, showcasing distant mountains under a cloudy sky. A waterfall is seen to the left, with a river flowing in the foreground, reflecting rocks in the water. A dense forest of tall trees is depicted in dark, detailed strokes. The brushstrokes capture textures of foliage and rocks, creating depth. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray and sepia.

artworks.title: Mountain PInes
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with dense trees alongside a river. The horizon is low, blending with the forest's silhouette. The technique is detailed with lines, suggesting sketching or etching. The color palette is mainly muted gray and sepia tones emphasizing light and shadow. Fallen trees and river rocks are close, interacting with the water. In the distance, dense foliage is softened by mountains fading into the sky. The sky has subtle tonal variations.

artworks.title: Shipwreck
artworks.medium: etching with roulette on chine collé
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape with powerful waves crashing around. The horizon is high in the image, where the sea meets the sky. The scene depicts a turbulent atmosphere. The brushstrokes are intense and swirling, capturing the movement of the water and clouds. The color palette is mainly black and gray. Three figures are depicted on a rocky outcrop or wave crest, with one figure raising their arms.

artworks.title: Mountain Stream
artworks.medium: etching with roulette on chine collé
artworks.description: The image shows a river scene surrounded by a forest area. The view is from a slight elevation, showcasing a mountainous landscape with distinct peaks against a textured sky. The etching features meticulous and detailed brushstrokes emphasizing textures of leaves, bark, and mountains. The color palette is monochromatic in varying shades of black and white. A small stream with rocks and vegetation is in the foreground, with towering trees on the left. In the distance, the view extends towards mountains, hills, and forested areas, creating a sense of depth and vastness.

artworks.title: Mountain Lake
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a calm body of water in the foreground. Lush trees, undulating hills, and mountains are visible in the background under a sky with soft cloud formations. The etching technique creates texture and depth through delicate, linear strokes. The color palette is monochromatic, with dark earthy tones in the foreground transitioning to lighter grays in the background, evoking a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Mountain Lakeside
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a point of view looking slightly upward across a calm, natural scene. The background features mountainous forms with engravings of trees and rocky textures. The brushstrokes create detailed foliage and rugged mountain surfaces. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray and black. Closest to the viewer, lush vegetation and tall grasses edge a serene body of water. Two small figures can be seen walking on a path, emphasizing the scale of the nature. The background has looming clouds, adding depth and atmosphere to the scene.

artworks.title: Trees in a Storm
artworks.description: The image depicts an outdoor landscape scene seen from a slightly elevated viewpoint. In the distance towards the left, there are mountains fading into the sky. In the central area, there is a copse of large trees casting shadows. Closest to the viewer, there is a small body of water winding through the scene, reflecting the surrounding land. An animal stands near the water. The sky is filled with dark clouds and some lighter areas, creating contrast. The etching technique used is intricate, with detailed cross-hatching adding texture and depth. The color palette is black and white, giving the image a dramatic effect.

artworks.title: Trees by a Rock
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from an elevated point. The horizon line is in the middle, where the sky meets distant mountains. Closest is a terrain with a small body of water reflecting light. Further back is a rocky hill with tall trees. The left side features rolling hills and vegetation. The etching technique uses fine lines for texture on foliage and rocks. The color palette is monochromatic with brown and sepia tones.

artworks.title: Dilapidated House
artworks.description: The image shows a weathered building surrounded by lush vegetation, set against mountainous terrain. The elevated perspective allows a detailed view of the scene with a focus on the building and foliage. The horizon is not prominent, and the mountains define the depth of the view. The sky suggests the horizon beyond the mountains with lighter shading. The image features fine etching for detailed textures in the building and vegetation. A monochromatic color scheme of sepia and brown enhances the depth and detail with a vintage quality. A stone path and plants in the foreground guide the viewer into the serene environment.

artworks.title: Chemin Creux
artworks.description: The image shows a winding path through a forest viewed from above. The trees obscure much of the horizon. The artwork is a fine etching with detailed textures in the trees and ground. The color scheme is monochromatic with shades of black, gray, and white. There are figures on the trail and by the trees.

artworks.title: Man Resting by a Stone Wall
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with a horizon in the upper third, dense foliage, intricate trees, a path beside a wooden fence, and a monochromatic color palette using shades of brown and black. The etching technique emphasizes detail in the foliage and light across the terrain.

artworks.title: Storm in the Mountains
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rugged terrain, scattered rocks, and small vegetation. Two figures are navigating the rocky area. The scene includes towering hills, rocky formations, an obscured horizon, turbulent sky with dark clouds and streaks of light, after a storm. The etching technique uses intricate brushstrokes to depict the sky and landforms with high contrasts. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on light and dark contrasts to enhance the landscape's ambiance.

artworks.title: Elephantiasis
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a statue of a standing figure. The image shows a photograph rendered in cyanotype. The figure stands straight with one leg slightly bent at the knee, wearing a wide-brimmed hat and boots. The texture of the statue is rough. The image captures the full figure on a plain background.

artworks.title: A Seated Man Nude and then Clothed
artworks.medium: graphite with white heightening on tan wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seated nude male figure. He is sitting on the floor with his legs folded beneath him, hands clasped together, and head turned to the side. The man's facial features are in profile, with a defined cheekbone and chin. His hair is short and neatly trimmed. Next to him is a detailed drawing of an upper torso clothed in a loose-fitting, long-sleeved garment with folds and creases, but missing a head or face. The background is a plain, neutral tone.

artworks.title: Hauling the Milk
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The black and white etching depicts a winter scene from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is high, showing rolling hills, trees, and a large barren tree on the left. The detailed and linear brushstrokes create textures in the snow, sky, and structures. The scene includes a dog, a horse-drawn sleigh, two figures, and a snow-covered building with icicles. The monochromatic color palette emphasizes the snowy landscape and architecture through light and shadow.

artworks.title: Wintry Fields
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with snow-covered hills rolling in the distance, scattered with trees. The brushstrokes are fine and detailed, defining the textures of the snow, trees, and animals. The color palette is monochrome, in black and white. In the foreground, there are deer on the snowy ground surrounded by leafless trees, with more trees scattered across the landscape leading to small clusters of buildings nestled in valleys. The hills in the distance are densely covered with lines, suggesting a mix of wooded and open areas against the sky.

artworks.title: Central City, Colorado
artworks.creditLine: Amon G. Carter Foundation Fund and Buffy and William Cafritz Fund

artworks.title: Nude with a Mirror, Standing Before a Washstand
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features bold, sweeping lines and shapes creating an abstract scene. Lines in the foreground loosely resemble human figures near a sink-like structure. The dynamic strokes and curves suggest a group with fluid movements. Another elongated figure is formed on the right, with a bucket-like shape at the bottom left. The abstract composition hints at people and a communal setting.

artworks.title: Dodo Seated
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a person sitting with their legs crossed. They are leaning slightly forward with one arm supporting them, and the other arm rests on their knee. The person's face is visible, featuring distinct facial features such as eyebrows, closed eyes, a straight nose, and lips. The figure's hair is styled, looking voluminous and shaped. The person is not wearing any clothing or accessories, and there are no additional elements or details in the background.

artworks.title: Two Bathers near the Woods
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a series of flowing lines and soft, sketchy shapes that form abstract human figures. Curved lines create the figures in a standing and reclining position. Broad strokes of green, blue, and red watercolor are applied around the figures, hinting at a background of landscape or vegetation. The standing figure wears a red cap. The reclining figure suggests a relaxed atmosphere.

artworks.title: Juno
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 14.3 x 11.4 cm (5 5/8 x 4 1/2 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a person standing on an uneven surface with flowing garments. Their position is slightly turned, with one arm extended outward and the other bent at the elbow, holding a slender stick or staff. The face appears delicate and serene, with hair styled high and decorative elements on the head. They are dressed in a long robe, with the cloth draping elegantly, suggesting movement. The figure is surrounded by cloud-like patterns and stands on rocks or a landscape with foliage details. There is a swirling cloud pattern in the background, adding to the mythical quality of the scene.

artworks.title: Fränzi and Marcella in the Studio
